mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 0.2% above the previous month signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) consistently indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening economic activity, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals active monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic expansions, rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals sustained economic momentum, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated business confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of strong economic expansion periods when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
